item.title: 73 employees released from Silver Springs Bottled Water Co. months after sale to Niagara
item.description: The first round of layoffs at the Silver Springs Bottled Water Co., which was scheduled for New Year's Eve, saw the release of 73 employees of the company, while the remaining dozen employees are scheduled for termination by the end of March. item.title: Hugh G. Hall
item.description: Hugh Hall will be remembered as kind, stubborn, steadfast, and unapologetically himself. If he loved you, you knew it and those who knew him were better for it. Read more: Hugh G. Hall

item.title: Northwest Ocala horse farm sells for $6.1 million
item.description: A 27-acre horse farm with several upgrades, including a professional riding arena, multiple paddocks, a heated saltwater pool, and a solar power system with a Tesla battery backup, was just sold this week for $6.1 million. Read more: Northwest Ocala horse farm sells for $6.1 million

item.title: Marion County officials discussing new rules for private airports and fly-in communities
item.description: The Marion County Land Development Regulation Commission (LDRC) is preparing to review significant changes to the county’s land development code regarding the approval and expansion of private airports and residential "fly-in" communities. item.title: I pay more in property taxes in Marion County than I did in Palm Beach and there was better infrastructure there.
item.description: "I agree with others who have stated taxes are too high in Marion County, especially for seniors. I live in an HOA on leased land. It is a very small plot and I am paying $2,300. I lived in Palm Beach County previously and paid less. We had much better infrastructure. At least we had lights on major roads not darkness like on State Road 200 in southwest Ocala.
